summary: Develop review controls for AI-assisted legal research, contracts and matter workflows. Explore the five-day AI legal training course.
lede: AI legal training helps in-house counsel, law-firm teams and legal operations professionals assess AI-assisted work in legal workflows. Participants practise screening use cases, setting controls for confidential inputs, tracing sources in research outputs, and defining human review and escalation steps for contract analysis and matter records, with exercises in risk assessment, workflow documentation and governance controls.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who handle legal analysis, documents, advice or matter workflows and need a practical method for assessing AI-assisted work. It suits legal teams exploring generative AI while keeping confidentiality, source quality and lawyer oversight central.
modules: Legal AI Reporting and Action Plan
prerequisites: Working familiarity with legal research, contract review or matter-management workflows is expected. No coding or programming is required.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
